documentation:
This UDT interfaces with the REST API WM_API_Avantes that in turn interfaces with a USB connected Aantes NIR device by calling HTTP Request functions. The UDT sends and receives data from the PLC using OPC UA.

Usage:
Each NIR device has a unique serial number (UDT paremeter DeviceSerialNumber);
The API that interfaces with the NIR devices has an IP and port (UDT paremeters DeviceIP and DevicePortNumber);
A PLC UDT (WM_AvantesNIR_UDT) needs to exist in PLC for each NIR device, the path to the PLC tags need to be configured as part of the SCADA UDT OPC parameters.
PLC should write to the respective PCmd tags as needed and wait for the respective Val_ status tags.

PCmd_ /OCmd_ Tags:
Used to trigger API calls when the Cmd tag value is changed from 0 to 1.
Tag value change script is triggered to make the respective API call.
Script will
	Set the respective status Val_ tag to -1 (In Process)
	Make the API call
	Set Val_ tag based on the returned status code of the API call
	Clear the Cmd_ tag back to 0

Supported API Calls:
Acquire/Release	Used to maintain or close connection to NIR device
Configure		Used to configure measurement before taking one. It will send the Cfg_ values to the NIR
Start/Stop		Used to start/stop measurement
GetData		Used to get raw data or get CSV file of data

Cfg_ tags are used to configure measurements in the NIR. Cfg values are send after a PCmd_Configure command
Status Val_ Tags are used to announce the status of the command (-1 = in progress, 200 = sucess, anything else should be an error)

tags.documentation:
Dynamic Parameter UDT. Can be used for EMs and UMs as needed.

Parameter faceplate will look at the DataType and change which tag to change accordantly.
It will browse the MES database for ENUM if ENUM datatype is used.

If there is a need to modify the write permissions lets say for a set of engineering parameters, do it in the instance level. Not in the UDT definition. By default those parameters are operator level and up.

If they are report parameters just set the Cfg_ReadWrite to false.

ConfirmReq is for future use only. It will eventually tie in e-sigs.

See Parameter Faceplate for full functionality documentation

eventScripts.script:
if not initialChange and currentValue.value == 1:
		ip = tag['parameters']['DeviceIP']
		port = tag['parameters']['DevicePortNumber']

		import java.lang.Exception
		# InProgress Status Code Tag (wait till is complete)
		system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]Val_Msg"], ["Getting Prediction Status"])
		try:
			tag = system.tag.readBlocking("[.]Val_TaskID")
			cfg_value = tag[0].value
			cfg = cfg_value.replace('"', '')
			
			response = WM_API.WebApp.get_results(task_id=cfg)
			
			# Set status code to match (Async)
			if response.statusCode == 200:
				system.tag.writeBlocking("[.]Val_PredictionStatus", response.statusCode)
				system.tag.writeBlocking("[.]Val_Msg", "Prediction Status Obtained")
				system.tag.writeAsync("[.]Val_Status", 35)
			else:
				system.tag.writeBlocking("[.]Val_Msg", "Error Trying to Getting Prediction Status")
				system.tag.writeAsync("[.]Val_Status", 36)
		except Exception, e:
			system.tag.writeBlocking("[.]Val_Msg", "Error Trying to Getting Prediction Status")
			system.tag.writeAsync("[.]Val_Status", 36)
			raise e # Catching, updaing status tags then raise exception
		except java.lang.Exception, e:
			system.tag.writeBlocking("[.]Val_Msg", "Error Trying to Getting Prediction Status")
			system.tag.writeAsync("[.]Val_Status", 36)
			raise e # Catching, updaing status tags then raise exception
			
		finally:
			# Clear Command
			system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPath, 0)
